newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta call money traded at 8.5/9.0 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta call money traded at 8.5/9.0 percent.

text.p: Jakarta call money was traded at 8.5/9.0 percent on Thursday morning on the back of ample rupiah supply in the money market, dealers said.

They said central bank dollar buying on Tuesday to keep the dollar within the bank's band seemed to have caused the market to be flushed with liquidity, coupled with a moderate central bank injection of some 238 billion rupiah this morning.
Dealers estimated the central bank to have bought some $500 million from the market on Tuesday.
Short-dated swaps declined on the back of ample liquidity which also seemed to have dragged down longer-term rates.
Overnight swap was at 0.25 and tom/next at 1.5 points.
Dealers said liquidity on Thursday was not affected by the offering of PT Bank Negara Indonesia shares which ends today.
The average overnight interbank rate on Wednesday was 11.79 percent, compared with 11.77 percent on Tuesday.
